source_note: FY2025 and the FY2024 comparative row values come from the audited statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (page 33) and the results at a glance: Revenue 301,720,553 / 323,127,667; Cost of sales 279,042,837 / 296,773,205; Gross profit 22,677,716 / 26,354,462; finance cost 10,776,847 / 3,953,746; profit before tax 2,677,670 / 11,004,039; income tax 499,172 / 2,230,505; profit for the year 2,178,498 / 8,773,534; basic EPS 314 / 1,264 kobo. Cost of Sales is stored positive so that Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. Figures NGN thousands. Two FY2021 cells were removed as duplicates of other periods rather than FY2021 data: Cost of Sales held 279,042,837 (the FY2025 figure) and Operating Profit (EBIT) held 574,298,826 (larger than the whole FY2021 revenue). FY2021 to FY2023 Revenue, Cost of Sales and Gross Profit still need re-collection from their own filings: the stored FY2022 revenue of 13,905,300 thousand and gross profit of 13,905,297 thousand imply a 100 percent margin. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
